issues.on_page: MFO payment 11,631 (Schedule 4 p12: 'MFO payments received', Fire fund)
issues.issue: MFO is most likely a fire Mutual Finance Organization payment, which passes through state mutual finance assistance. That makes it intergovernmental/state aid, not a fee. Exhibit B (p2) lists it under general revenues, not charges for services. The same applies to detail[27].category/detail_category (other charges for services).

Treated as a county payment, but the label says tax and Exhibit B (p2) counts it in Taxes 30,222 (= property 28,778 + county road tax 1,444). It could be property tax/other taxes. The same applies to detail[34].
The grant's source (state, federal or private) is not stated anywhere in the trimmed PDF, so state aid is an assumption. The same applies to detail[10] (detail_category other state aid).

This line has a matching expenditure, 'Sales tax remitted' 1,227 (detail[19]). It looks like sales tax the city collects on its own sales and passes to the state, not local option sales tax revenue. Category is doubtful.

Schedule 2 (p10) shows this line is licenses, fees and permits 3,293 + materials and services sold and refunds 40,887 + sales tax collected 1,274 (= 45,454). It is a mixed line with no review flag. Dominant category is acceptable.
